param.name: homeSector
param.default: if @this.ship.commanderentity.$config_subordinate_range then @this.ship.commanderentity.$config_subordinate_range else (if @this.ship.commander.jobmainsector then this.ship.commander.jobmainsector else (if @this.ship.commander.isclass.[class.station, class.buildstorage] then this.ship.commander.sector else (if this.ship.jobmainsector then this.ship.jobmainsector else this.sector)))

param.name: maxDistanceAround
param.comment: Max gate distance from Home sector to rescue

input_param.name: max
input_param.value: (if @this.ship.pilot.skill.piloting lt 6 then 0 else if @this.ship.pilot.skill.piloting lt 9 then 1 else if @this.ship.pilot.skill.piloting lt 12 then 2 else 3) + (if @player.entity.$RescueRangersConfig.$extraRange gt 0 then player.entity.$RescueRangersConfig.$extraRange else 0)

patch.comment: Set to false as new value
enable feature to return them on replacement ship

debug_text.text: 'RescueRangers [%s at %s, Mode: %s] - %s rescued joined the crew. Service: %s, marines: %s, unassigned: %s' .[ this.assignedcontrolled.debugname, this.assignedcontrolled.sector.knownname, @$rescueMode, $crewToAssign.count, this.assignedcontrolled.people.{entityrole.service}.count, this.assignedcontrolled.people.{entityrole.marine}.count, this.assignedcontrolled.people.{entityrole.unassigned}.count, ]

set_value.name: $stasisNow
set_value.exact: if @$stasisMode == 1 then 'off' else if @$stasisMode == 2 then 'overflow' else if @$stasisMode == 3 then 'instead' else @player.entity.$RescueRangersConfig.$stasisMode

do_if.value: not $stasisStation.dockingenabled or not $stasisStation.dockingallowed.{this.assignedcontrolled} or not @$stasisStation.dock.{$stasisDockSize}.isdockingallowed or @$stasisStation.dock.{$stasisDockSize}.todockpos == null
